Blinkit Store Expansion vs. Store-Level Throughput Maturation

Throughput per store-day = NOV * 10^7 / (Period-End Stores * 91.25). In Q1 FY25, Blinkit Net Order Value (NOV) was ₹4,061.0 Cr across 639 period-end dark stores, yielding an average throughput of ₹696,465 (~₹6.96 lakh) per store-day. By Q2 FY27, dark stores quadrupled (+322.5% to 2,700 stores) while NOV expanded to ₹20,940.0 Cr (+415.6%), driving average throughput up to ₹849,924 (~₹8.50 lakh) per store-day (+22.0% throughput expansion). [AUDIT NOTE: Prior preliminary drafts erroneously plugged in Swiggy Instamart's GOV of ₹2,724 Cr and ₹9,230 Cr into Blinkit's throughput formula, generating a spurious -20% contraction. Using Blinkit's true disclosed NOV demonstrates robust +22.0% throughput expansion despite massive store footprint scaling].
